## Technical Writer

## Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer to join our team and produce clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation that supports both internal operations and end-user understanding. This role is central to bridging the gap between complex technical concepts and accessible written content across a range of formats and platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong research capabilities, excellent written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts, developers, and stakeholders. A background in a technical discipline combined with a passion for clear communication would make you an exceptional fit for this position.

## Key Responsibilities

- Research, develop, and maintain a broad range of technical documentation including user manuals, handbooks, training materials, standard operating procedures, and multimedia content

- Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and accurate content tailored to the intended audience, whether end users, internal teams, or stakeholders

- Collaborate closely with engineers, developers, product managers, and subject matter experts to gather information and verify technical accuracy across all documentation

- Plan, organise, and manage documentation projects from initial brief through to final publication, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met

- Review and edit existing documentation to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or outdated content, and update materials to reflect product or process changes

- Develop and apply style guides, templates, and documentation standards to ensure consistency in tone, format, and terminology across all written outputs

- Produce content for digital and print formats including online help systems, knowledge bases, e-learning modules, and technical reference guides

- Liaise with stakeholders to understand documentation requirements and translate business or technical briefs into structured, reader-focused content

- Conduct quality assurance reviews of documentation prior to release, checking for technical accuracy, readability, grammar, and adherence to brand and style guidelines

- Support the development of training materials and contribute to onboarding programmes by producing clear instructional content for new users or staff

- Manage version control and document repositories, ensuring all materials are correctly filed, versioned, and accessible to relevant teams

## Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Technical Writing, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

- Demonstrated experience in a technical writing role, ideally within a corporate, technology, or engineering environment

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy

- Proven ability to research, interpret, and document complex technical subjects in a clear and accessible manner

- Proficiency in documentation tools such as MadCap Flare, Confluence, Microsoft Word, or equivalent platforms

- Experience working with content management systems, version control tools, and document repositories

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines

- Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and build effective relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Sound understanding of documentation best practices, including the use of style guides such as the Microsoft Manual of Style or equivalent

## Preferred Qualifications

- Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Technical Communication, such as a Certificate IV in Professional Writing and Editing or equivalent

- Experience with API documentation, software development lifecycle (SDLC), or working within Agile project environments

- Familiarity with graphic design or multimedia tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Snagit, or Camtasia to support visual documentation

- Exposure to single-sourcing methodologies and structured authoring frameworks such as DITA

- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare, finance, or engineering where documentation compliance is essential

## Why Join Us?

- Flexible working arrangements including hybrid and remote options to support a healthy work-life balance

- A collaborative, inclusive team culture that values expertise, continuous learning, and professional growth

- Access to ongoing training, professional development programmes, and support for further education or industry certifications

- Meaningful work that directly contributes to product quality, customer experience, and organisational knowledge

- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits reviewed annually in line with performance

- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

- Plan, develop, and maintain customer access telecommunications network infrastructure to support organisational growth and service delivery objectives
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and service providers to manage contractual obligations, monitor performance delivery, and ensure agreed service levels are met

- Provide ongoing operational support by troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving network performance malfunctions, defects, and faults in a timely manner
- Conduct detailed network capacity planning and demand forecasting to anticipate future infrastructure requirements and prevent service degradation
- Analyse network data and performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement targeted optimisation strategies
- Prepare and maintain accurate technical documentation, including network plans, design specifications, and project reports
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, operations, and project management to deliver network projects on time and within budget
- Assess and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to support continuous improvement across the network planning function
- Ensure all planning activities comply with relevant industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal governance frameworks
- Support field teams and technical staff by providing clear guidance and planning documentation during network rollout and upgrade activities
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in telecommunications network planning, design, or a closely related technical role
- Strong working knowledge of customer access network technologies, including fibre, copper, HFC, and wireless infrastructure
- Proficiency in network planning and design tools, GIS platforms, and relevant industry software
- Solid understanding of network protocols, architecture principles, and performance management practices
- Proven ability to analyse complex technical data, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions
- Experience managing and coordinating external vendors and suppliers, including oversight of contractual performance
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver outcomes within defined timeframes
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Postgraduate qualifications or industry certifications in telecommunications, network engineering, or project management (e.g. CCNP, PMP, or equivalent)
- Experience working within NBN, fibre-to-the-premises (FTTP), or large-scale national telecommunications rollout programmes
- Familiarity with Australian telecommunications regulatory frameworks and industry standards
- Experience with predictive network modelling and simulation tools
- Exposure to agile or structured project delivery methodologies within a telecommunications context
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a forward-thinking organisation at the forefront of Australia's telecommunications infrastructure development
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including training, certifications, and career progression pathways
- Enjoy a flexible and supportive work environment that values work-life balance and employee wellbeing
- Collaborate with a highly skilled and experienced team across a diverse range of network planning projects
- Competitive remuneration package with opportunities for performance-based recognition and growth
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

About the role 

DekkoSecure is an international technology company with deep expertise in protecting highly sensitive and mission critical data. DekkoSecure's focus is building military-grade, end-to-end encrypted security workflow solutions for government, law enforcement agencies, defence primes, and the enterprise healthcare sector. Our product suite includes DekkoCORE, a highly secure platform for file sharing and collaboration, and DekkoDEMS, purpose-built for digital evidence management. As we scale, we are creating a dedicated Business Systems Analyst position to sit at the centre of our product, support, commercial and operations functions. 

The Business Systems Analyst is responsible for eliciting and documenting business and system requirements, analysing existing processes and data, and translating client and internal needs into clear functional specifications and improved system functionality. The role is the central reference point between platform users, the product and engineering teams, and the wider business, ensuring that changes to our systems and processes are well specified, tested and adopted. 

Key responsibilities 

We are seeking an engaging, organised and analytical individual with advanced written and verbal communication skills who can: 

 * Work with platform users, clients and internal teams to draw out what they need from DekkoSecure’s systems, pin those needs down precisely, and write them up as requirements that both the business and the engineering team can build against. 

* Engage with users and clients across the company’s Australian, Northern European and North American markets to elicit, formulate and document business and system requirements, and to analyse how the platform is used in each market. 

* Examine how work currently flows through the company’s support, onboarding and data-handling activities and build process and data maps that expose where the business loses time, drops information or breaks down. 

* Analyse client usage of the platform to identify adoption patterns, friction points and where users encounter difficulty or inefficiency, feeding these findings back to the product and engineering teams with recommendations for improvement. 

* Weigh the available options and put forward the process changes and system behaviour the business should adopt, ranking each recommendation by the value it returns and the number of users it affects. 

* Turn agreed requirements into functional specifications the product and engineering teams can build from, across both DekkoCORE and DekkoDEMS. 

* Apply data and process modelling techniques to design and document how information and processes flow across core business systems, establishing and maintaining a single source of truth. 

* Set the test plans and acceptance criteria each change has to pass and run that testing, so nothing reaches production or client use until it holds up against the agreed requirements. 

* Run analysis and implementation work as planned, costed and resourced initiatives using agile methods, including the programmes to consolidate the company’s systems and formalise its processes, and track them through to delivery. 

* Design and maintain reporting and forecasting dashboards that give leadership accurate, data-driven visibility of system and operational performance. 

* Create and maintain documentation, including internal standard operating procedures for staff and external user guides and Help Center content for clients. 

* Conduct training and structured walkthroughs of new and changed platform functionality for internal users and clients to support adoption and validate that delivered changes meet acceptance criteria. 

* Be the person the business turns to on how its systems and processes work, advising the product, support, commercial and operations teams when they need to make system or process decisions. 

Skills, qualifications, experience required 

* A relevant tertiary qualification in information technology, business informatics, or a related cross-functional business and information technology discipline. A postgraduate qualification combining information technology and business is highly regarded. 

* Experience working in a start-up or scale-up environment in a client-facing role. 

* Willingness to undertake occasional international travel to Europe and North America for requirements gathering. 

* Ability to understand user and client needs and translate them into documented system and process requirements. 

* Demonstrated ability to translate user and client needs into documented system and product improvements within a software or SaaS environment. 

* Experience with CRM systems, document and collaboration platforms. 

* Competence in data and process modelling, and in producing clear system specifications and process documentation. 

* Experience preparing and delivering user training. 

* Strong stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical teams. 



Desirable 

* Exposure to secure collaboration, document management or cybersecurity software products. 

* Familiarity with project management methodologies (for example Agile) and supporting tools. 

* Experience supporting product roadmap decisions through structured feedback and analysis. 

How to apply 

Applications must be submitted through this advertisement. Please include a current resume and a short cover letter addressing the essential skills and experience above. Applications are open to Australian citizens and permanent residents and to other candidates with valid work rights in Australia.

You will perform fibre splicing, network testing, fault diagnosis and commissioning activities between the exchange and customer network boundary, while ensuring compliance with Telstra, NBN and company technical standards.  As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in delivering telecommunications infrastructure projects across New South Wales.(Sydney & Newcastle) You will work closely with project managers, clients and field teams to support network upgrades, customer connections and maintenance activities, while contributing to the successful delivery of high-quality telecommunications solutions.   Duties included are:    Install, commission and maintain fibre optic and telecommunications network infrastructure across Telstra and NBN projects.   Perform fibre handling, cable hauling, splicing, termination, testing and fault diagnosis using OTDR, power meters and other telecommunications testing equipment.   Conduct network fault finding, diagnostics and preventative maintenance to ensure reliable network performance.   Interpret telecommunications network plans, design drawings and technical specifications to complete field installations.   Configure, commission and test fibre optic network components to ensure network performance and service quality.   Manage client sites and coordinate field activities to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently and in compliance with client requirements.   Prepare technical reports, test results, as-built documentation, installation records and upload project artefacts through client management systems.   Assist with telecommunications network upgrades, commissioning activities and customer network connections.   Assist with minor civil works associated with the installation of telecommunications infrastructure, including conduit preparation, pit and pipe works, cable hauling and site set-up where required.   Ensure all installations and maintenance activities comply with Telstra, NBN and company technical standards, quality requirements and safety procedures.    Skills and experience:    Minimum one year of experience in fibre optic telecommunications, telecommunications network installation, or a related field.   Qualification in Information Technology (Telecommunications Network Engineering) or a related discipline.   Demonstrated experience in fibre handling, splicing, testing and fault diagnosis using telecommunications testing equipment (e.g. OTDR and power meters).   Strong knowledge of Telstra and NBN fibre optic networks, installation standards and commissioning procedures.   Experience interpreting telecommunications network plans, technical drawings and specifications.   Knowledge of telecommunications civil infrastructure, including conduit, pit and pipe installations and cable hauling.   Experience operating plant and equipment, including excavators (desirable).   Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve network faults.   Excellent organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and client requirements.   Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.   Willingness to learn, adapt to new technologies and work across a variety of project environments.      WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?    The successful candidate will:   Have the ability to work (Monday to Friday)  Be well organised  Have attention to detail  Be self-motivated and willing to learn  Be able to prioritise and manage time  Be able to work with multiple senior level employees and manage upwards and downwards  prior experience required!        About Company     Civil Network Corp is a progressive Fibre & Civil works contractor based in Sydney & Newcastle with ongoing projects right across the state providing design, construction, management, maintenance, and field services solutions for fixed and wireless networks. Driven by our values - delivering results, building strong relationships, and striving for continual progression.         Salary:  $80000-90000   Job Publish:  20-07-2026   Job Expire:  19-08-2026  Apply on:  Telecommunications field engineer Job here!
